祝贺你殖民了一颗新星球！殖民者正在建造他们的第一个殖民地，想要让他们自给自足，则还需要一段时间。

£colony£殖民地在第一个定居点建设完成完成前会不断消耗我们的资源，所以不要一次性对过多£planet£行星进行殖民。
texts.en:
Congratulations on having colonized a new world! Our colonists are now in the process of building their first settlement, but it will take time for them to become self-sufficient.

The £colony£ Colony will be a drain on our resources until the first settlement has been completed, so take care not to colonize too many £planet£ Planets at once.
